    16	- **Detection boundary** (Donoho-Jin, 2004; also Ingster et al.): For sparse Gaussian mixture detection in $\ell_2$-sparse regime $\varepsilon_n = n^{-\beta}$, $\beta\in(0,1)$, the boundary is parameterized by $\rho_* = \sqrt{r/2}$:

    31	- Power: $\beta_B \to \alpha = 0.05$.
